sources.title: GTA 6 reinvigorates PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X console sales in the US, even at their inflated prices
sources.text: Despite the far higher prices of PlayStation and Xbox consoles today compared to their launch, or even the same period last year, both brands of console saw a significant boost in US sales leading up to the launch of this generation's biggest game: Grand Theft Auto 6. In the week ending 14th November, PS5 hardware unit sales registered a 2.4x increase over the same week last year. Xbox wasn't far behind, seeing a 2.3x increase in its own unit sales. That's according to industry analyst Mat Piscatella at Circana , who pulled the data from Circana's retail tracking service, which covers the US retail market. The PS5 Pro only accounted for less than 10 percent of the PlayStation's total unit sales, by the way, which Piscatella noted was "a LOT better than it has been in recent weeks", and seemingly the result of increased supply. GTA 6, of course, released on 19th November, so the surge in console hardware sales was clearly driven by the rush to attain consoles before the game came out. And while the GTA 6-driven demand isn't surprising, it's worth noting how much more expensive PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are today. A standard PS5 today costs $650, compared to $550 a year ago. The PS5 Pro saw a big jump from $750 last November to $900 today. The base Xbox Series X jumped from $650 last year to $800 today, while Series S now costs $500, up from $400. Even Switch 2, where GTA 6 is not available, saw a notable boost of 40 percent in hardware sales over the same period, driven by The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake and the special edition Zelda Switch 2 console . Circana's November US video game market report, which releases in December, is already one of the most anticipated this year, for digesting and documenting the GTA 6 effect. Worldwide, GTA 6 sold more than 32.5m copies in one day , making Rockstar's parent company Take-Two $3.79bn (£2.89bn) in revenue. We haven't had any updated official sales figures since; but estimates suggest the sales figure could be well into the 40-millions. Perhaps Rockstar is waiting to hit the nice round 50m sales mark before announcing it. If you're playing GTA 6, you may want to keep Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough to hand. It has plenty of very helpful guides covering the game's main missions, as well as explainers for mechanics like romance and the criminal profile , and even cheats for when you finish the game.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Sony Confirms PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026
sources.text: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4. In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic? IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017 . "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious , if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time. And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves." It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library. sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Out, and There Are Already Black Friday GTA 6 Deals
sources.text: Rockstar's GTA 6 has barely been out for a few days, but UK retailer ShopTo is already offering some surprisingly generous discounts on the new release across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — letting you pay as little as £53.85 for the game. Here's how to save on what's arguably the biggest game of all time. Despite Black Friday still being a week away, the store has slashed £16.14 off the standard Xbox version of Grand Theft Auto VI, bringing its usual £69.99 price down to £53.85 at ShopTo . That's 23% off for a direct digital code, with instant delivery, and no additional vouchers or memberships needed. Better still, there are a few other ways to save on Rockstar's latest blockbuster, depending on whether you're playing on Xbox or PS5, or fancy getting some bonus content with your purchase via the Ultimate Edition As for PS5 players, ShopTo's cheapest route is a little different, since getting digital game keys for PlayStation games outside of boxed codes and PlayStation itself is a lot trickier compared to Xbox titles. Instead of receiving GTA 6 itself, ShopTo can sell you a £70 PlayStation Store gift card for only £60.85 , which you can then redeem on your UK PSN account to buy the £69.99 Standard Edition — effectively earning you £9.15 in savings. On the other hand, for anyone who wants the closest thing to a physical version of GTA 6, both consoles have a £61.85 boxed option with an added A3 double-sided poster ; that also makes ShopTo the cheapest UK retailer to buy the boxed version of Grand Theft Auto VI from right now. Remember, though, these aren't actual disc versions of GTA 6; you'll find a download code inside the packaging instead. Also, for Xbox fans who were considering buying the Grand Theft Auto 6’s Ultimate Edition anyway, ShopTo also has said Ultimate Edition on Xbox for only £67.85 — an incredibly impressive £22.14 price drop and the lowest price we’ve seen for it yet. With the Ultimate Edition, compared to the Standard Edition of GTA VI, you’ll get extra vehicles, weapons, outfits, customisation features, and exclusive locations throughout Leonida. To get that aforementioned Ultimate Edition on PS5, however, you can also grab the £100 PlayStation Store Gift Card for only £85.85 to redeem the complete version of GTA 6 for £89.99. Sure, you’ll only save £41.14 instead of buying the game through the PS Store directly, but you’ll have an extra £10 credit to spend on other games and DLC on top. Otherwise, if you’re unsure about getting the Ultimate Edition on PlayStation 5 right away, you can always buy the £20 Ultimate Edition Upgrade directly from the PlayStation Store . The same goes for the bonus Grand Theft Auto VI Vintage Vice City Pack for £4.49 — featuring the stunning ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, alternative outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an exclusive Tropical Weapon Pattern inspired by Tommy Vercetti's iconic palm-tree shirt. At the time of writing, there is no physical disc version of GTA 6, along with there being no indication by Rockstar Games as to whether it will be putting out a disc'd edition of the game; with that, these deals are some of the best value you can get on the Grand Theft Auto sequel in the meantime. sources.title: GTA 6 Cooties Mission Walkthrough
sources.text: Wondering how to complete Cooties in GTA 6? The Cooties mission in GTA 6 sees Lucia join Dre’Quan Priest and the Real Dimez to film a music video for their latest track. However, the shoot takes an unexpected turn when DWNPLY and his crew arrive looking for revenge. If you’re struggling to complete the mission, here’s how to shoot the music video, escape DWNPLY’s crew and unlock the Bae-Luxe’s Bat reward. Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to checkÂ out ourÂ complete walkthrough hub , featuringÂ beginner tips , navigation experience explained , GTA 6 cheats , and more. To unlock Cooties, you’ll first need to complete the Ride or Die mission in Chapter 3. After a couple of in-game days, Jason’s friend Dre’Quan will contact you about filming a music video for the Real Dimez song, Cooties. To start the mission, head to the mission marker in Crosstown. For the first part of the mission you’ll play as Lucia during the music video shoot, which features DWNPLY’s stolen car from the Ride or Die mission. The first mission objective is to help the Real Dimez film their music video. Most of this section is scripted, but you’ll need to complete a few actions. You’ll need to drive the car on a predetermined route so that it can be filmed for the video. After driving through the city, you’ll eventually stop, at which point some guys will start harassing Lucia and the Dimez. Get out the car as Lucia and knock the guy out. You won’t be able to pull weapons here, but you won’t need to, he’ll go down in one punch. Once the confrontation is over, the girls will begin smashing up the car for the cameras. Lucia is handed a baseball bat, allowing you to join in. Finally, you’ll need to spray-paint the vehicle. Shake the spray can using X on PlayStation or A on Xbox , then hold R2/RT to paint the side of the car. With the music video finished, DWNPLY and his crew arrive looking for their car. Jump behind the wheel and make your escape. You’ll need to lose the pursuing vehicles and drive outside the red danger area displayed on your map. If you destroy the car, the mission will fail, or if either of the Dimez are thrown out of the car due to a big crash, the mission will also fail. Keep moving and if any of the DWNPLY cars get too close, shoot their wheels in Focus Mode to take them out quickly. Once all the pursuing cars have disappeared and you’ve escaped the marked area, the objective will update. With DWNPLY’s crew gone,Â follow the objective marker towards the recording studio. Drive the damaged vehicle towards the destination to trigger the final sequence and complete the mission.

stories.title: GTA 6 launch knocked Call of Duty's daily players down 42 percent, Alinea estimates
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 's launch took a big bite out of Call of Duty’s player base, according to new estimates from Alinea Analytics, and four days on, it still hasn't recovered. Read more

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: GTA 6 launch knocked Call of Duty's daily players down 42 percent, Alinea estimates
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6's launch took a big bite out of Call of Duty’s player base, according to new estimates from Alinea Analytics, and four days on, it still hasn't recovered. Writing in Alinea's newsletter , Rhys Elliott said Call of Duty HQ's daily active users (DAUs) across PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam fell 42 percent when GTA 6 launched on 19th November, dropping from an average of 7.5 million to 4.4 million. On PlayStation, which Elliott describes as "CoD's main platform", the drop was 44 percent. "Sadly, CoD has barely bounced back after four days," Elliott wrote. "It's still down 41% from its baseline." Fortnite and FC 27 took a hit too, but both are already recovering. Fortnite's DAUs on PlayStation and Xbox fell 28 percent, from 17.8 million to 12.8 million, but by the end of the weekend it had clawed its way back to 19 percent below its baseline. Epic is also holding a live event to close out the current season on 5th December, which Elliott says the studio "hopes will pull players back after they’ve polished off GTA 6’s story". FC 27's DAUs dropped by around 27 percent, from 5.9 million to 4.3 million, and it's already back within 20 percent of its baseline. GTA 6's launch hit Call of Duty HARD ( @alineaanalytics estimates). COD HQ's daily active users across PlayStation, Xbox, and Steam are down 42% from an average of 7.5M DAUs to 4.4M. On PlayStation – CoD’s main platform – Call of Duty took a 44% hit. Sadly, CoD has barely bounced… pic.twitter.com/XLa6N9TBfr According to Alinea, of those who'd played GTA 6 by the end of its launch weekend, 29 percent had also played Fortnite this month, 16 percent had played Call of Duty HQ, and 11 percent had played FC 27. Elliott said the pattern is largely what Alinea had predicted: the big live service games took an instant hit from GTA, but bounced back "because they're ingrained habits". Call of Duty is "the outlier here", he added, "and Xbox should - candidly - be worried about one of its premier franchises". Elliott also points out that all of this is the impact of GTA 6's single-player mode. He expects its online component and PC port to arrive "some time next year", and when they do, he says, "the bounce back will not be so obtainable". Alinea also estimates that GTA 6 has sold 44.9 million copies and made more than $4 billion since launch. GTA 6 launched on Thursday, 19th November, for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. While it's the biggest entertainment launch of all time , selling 32.5 million pre-release copies and making $3.79 billion by the end of its first day, you wouldn't know it from its Metacritic user score , as players review bomb it over its limited FPS and purported "woke" agenda. Eurogamer called GTA 6 an open world of "awe, minute detail and impossible scale" in our five-star GTA 6 review . If you need help getting through the game now that it's here, you can check out Eurogamer's Grand Theft Auto 6 walkthrough and a breakdown of our Grand Theft Auto 6 cheats .

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Analyst estimates Call of Duty lost 44% of its players when GTA 6 came out, and unlike fans of its live-service competitors they've been slow to come back
sources.text: Turns out Fortnite players are more loyal. Sony has been crowing about Grand Theft Auto 6 setting a new record for concurrent PlayStation players , which isn't bad for a game that's currently only singleplayer. It isn't just beating the records set by the giants of multiplayer gaming back when they released, though. It's also eating their lunch right now. Alinea Analytics reports that Call of Duty, Fortnite, and EA Sports FC 27 all saw their number of daily active users drop when GTA 6 released. "Call of Duty got it the worst of the three," Alinea's head of market analysis Rhys Elliott wrote, "dropping 42% from an average of 7.5M DAUs to 4.4M" according to the company's estimates. Fortnite only lost 28% of its players, the firm claims based on PlayStation and Xbox data—Alinea's Fortnite figures do not take Switch, mobile, or Epic Games Store players into account—An estimated five million of them choosing to buy groceries and fix the stairs instead of parachuting out of a bus over the weekend. EA Sports FC 27 suffered a similar loss. "FC 27's DAUs dropped by about 27% when GTA 6 launched," according to Elliott, "from 5.9M to 4.3M." But where player numbers for both of those games were trending back up four days after GTA 6's release, Call of Duty has struggled to win its players back, Elliott says: "Sadly, CoD has barely bounced back after four days. It's still down 41% from its baseline." During that time Call of Duty had a Thanksgiving-themed event, while FC 27 had a Black Friday discount and in-game "Thunderstruck" promotion, and Fortnite's ongoing Treasure Hunters event is adding a bunch of One Piece stuff. If you're going up against a cultural juggernaut like GTA, I guess crossing over with something as massive as One Piece is the way to do it. As Elliott concludes, this is only part one of the story. When Rockstar comes back for the second bite of this apple its rivals might have an even harder fight on their hands: "When the online component and PC port of GTA 6 hits (some time next year simultaneously, I'd imagine), then the bounce back will not be so obtainable." sources.text: O lançamento ocorreu na quarta-feira, 18, e logo se tornou a maior estreia de um jogo na história das transmissões ao vivo. Crédito: Estadão A Black Friday já começou no Xbox, e a plataforma da MS tem uma grande variedade de lançamentos e clássicos a preços bem mais baixos temporariamente. Durante o período da BF, é possível garantir ótimos títulos entre os jogos em promoção na Microsoft Store , que nesta semana traz títulos com até 95% de desconto . Por exemplo, entre as ofertas para Xbox em destaque temos games como Gears of War: E-Day , The Blood of Dawnwalker , Halo: Campaign Evolved , Red Dead Redemption 2 e Rogue Legacy , que está custando apenas R$ 3,05 . Leia também Rockstar revela inspirações reais de Jason, protagonista de GTA 6 Rockstar revela inspirações reais de Jason, protagonista de GTA 6 Vem com a gente conferir os jogos de Xbox no precinho e aproveite para aumentar o backlog com um monte de jogão em promoção. A seguir, você confere a nossa lista com as principais promoções de jogos para Xbox One, Series S e Series X disponíveis nesta semana na Microsoft Store: Ainda não tem seu Xbox? Então pare de marcar bobeira, aproveite as promoções e use o cupom KaBuM! para adquirir o seu Xbox Series S ou Series X novinho com desconto o quanto antes! Existe uma forma de aliviar um pouco as finanças e parcelar os jogos de Xbox que a gente tanto quer — e com direito a cashback — usando os gift cards da Nuuvem . Na Nuuvem é possível parcelar a compra em até 4x sem juros no PayPal ou em até 6x sem juros no cartão de crédito . E o melhor: você ainda recebe cashback em forma de moedinhas na própria plataforma, que podem ser usadas em compras futuras e abater parte do valor do pagamento final. Você pode comprar desde gift cards a cartões de assinaturas do Xbox Game Pass e, além do cashback, ainda pode usar cupons de desconto que vez ou outra são liberados pela galera da Nuuvem. E aí, aproveitou para comprar algum dos jogos para Xbox em promoção ? Nos conte nas redes sociais do Voxl! Essa matéria não é patrocinada, mas contém links de parceiros. O TecMundo pode ganhar comissão pelas vendas geradas por meio desses links. Reiteramos nosso compromisso em indicar apenas produtos e promoções curados e selecionados pelos nossos especialistas, sempre levando em consideração a experiência dos nossos leitores. stories.title: Switch 2’s Black Friday Bundle With Mario Kart World Is Available Now For $500
stories.summary: It's Black Friday week, and one of the best gaming deals is a Switch 2 bundle featuring Mario Kart World and other extras for $50 off the normal price. As announced previously , the $500 bundle comes with a Switch 2 and a digital copy of Mario Kart World, as well as a three-month Nintendo Switch Online membership. sources.title: Digimon Alysion now available
sources.text: Digimon Alysion , the free-to-play mobile game based on Digimon Card Game , is now available for iOS via App Store and Android via Google Play in 183 countries and regions, Bandai Card Games announced . To celebrate surpassing 450,000 pre-registrations, all players will receive tickets that can be redeemed for game-exclusive cards, card packs, and a secret rare card, with more rewards planned. Here is an overview of the game, via Bandai Card Games: Digimon Alysion is finally here! Enjoy a brand-new Digimon card game world! And that’s not all! There’s plenty of other features that make the Digimon Card Game easy and fun to play! Whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just getting started, come and experience the Digimon Card Game by playing Digimon Alysion ! This application is distributed under the official rights from the license holder.
